## Summary

**Bug**: The `stringifyName` function in `src/index.ts` used `next.value[0]` to check if the next text token starts with an `ID_CONTINUE` character. For astral (non-BMP) Unicode characters, `string[0]` returns only the first UTF-16 code unit (surrogate), which fails the `/u`-flag regex test. This caused parameter names followed by astral ID_Continue characters to not be quoted, breaking parse→stringify→parse round-trips.

**Fix**: Changed `next.value[0]` to `[...next.value][0]` on line 679, which spreads the string into an array of Unicode code points before indexing, correctly handling astral characters.

**Single-line change** in `src/index.ts`:
```diff
-  if (next?.type === "text" && ID_CONTINUE.test(next.value[0])) {
+  if (next?.type === "text" && ID_CONTINUE.test([...next.value][0])) {
```
